package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {rows:=[][2]float64{};for _,raw:=range x["windows"].([]any){v:=raw.([]any);a,b:=v[0].(float64),v[1].(float64);if a<b{rows=append(rows,[2]float64{a,b})}};sort.Slice(rows,func(i,j int)bool{return rows[i][0]<rows[j][0]||(rows[i][0]==rows[j][0]&&rows[i][1]<rows[j][1])});out:=[][2]float64{};for _,v:=range rows{n:=len(out);if n>0&&v[0]<=out[n-1][1]{if v[1]>out[n-1][1]{out[n-1][1]=v[1]}}else{out=append(out,v)}};return out}
